newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle futures tumble on weak cash, sell stops.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle futures tumble on weak cash, sell stops.

text.p: CME live cattle futures moved lower in late active trading in reaction to weak cash cattle and beef prices, traders said.
Declines increased when chart-based selling occurred in the June contract, which pushed that contract to a session low of 63.100 cents per lb, down 0.950.

Cash beef prices have fallen steadily and recently reached the lowest level since late February, traders said. Also, meat packers bid $65.00 per cwt for cattle in the High Plains feedlots early Monday, down $2.00 from last week's sales, traders said.
At 1251 CDT, live cattle were down 0.900 to up 0.075 cent with June off the most at 63.150.
